item: [L2] item 4: strace in the dev image (egress check)
why: egress/run_traced.sh records network system calls with strace. ubuntu:24.04 does not ship it.

candidates.pin: apt-get install strace=<noble version>; record `dpkg-query -W strace`. calibration.md step 1 checks that ptrace works in the L2 sandbox.

why: README section 5 fixes ubuntu:24.04 as the base and asks for the image digest; gen_log.py and check_clean.py need python3 (they can also run on the grader host). Bare `pip install` is blocked on Ubuntu 24.04, which README section 5 already handles (needed_venv).

candidates.license: Ubuntu base image; packages under their own licenses (python3: PSF-2.0)
candidates.size: About 30 MB compressed base, plus python3, python3-venv, pip, git, ca-certificates, curl, strace.
candidates.pin: Same dev image as q01 and q04: base pinned by digest, apt packages at recorded versions, final image digest recorded in calibration.md.
